mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW ( RATING, CONTENT, REVIEW_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ITEM_ID, TITLE ) VALUES ( #{rating}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW(), #{userId}, #{productId}, #{itemId}, #{title} )
mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.REVIEW_STATUS, R.HELPFUL_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(R.UPDATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS updatedAt, R.USER_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.TITLE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, ( SELECT RI.IMG_URL FROM REVIEW_IMG RI WHERE RI.REVIEW_ID = R.REVIEW_ID ORDER BY RI.IMG_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.REVIEW_STATUS != 'DELETED' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND REVIEW_STATUS != 'DELETED'

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.REVIEW_STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(R.UPDATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS updatedAt, R.USER_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.TITLE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, ( SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET TITLE = #{title}, RATING = #{rating}, CONTENT = #{content}, REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT IMG_ID, REVIEW_ID, IMG_URL FROM REVIEW_IMG WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} ORDER BY IMG_ID ASC

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.RATING AS rating, R.CONTENT AS content, R.REVIEW_STATUS AS reviewStatus, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(R.UPDATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS updatedAt, R.USER_ID AS userId, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImgUrl, U.GRADE_ID AS gradeId, R.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, R.TITLE AS title, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, R.HELPFUL_COUNT AS helpfulCount, CASE WHEN RH.HELPFUL_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS helpfulYn, ( SELECT RI.IMG_URL FROM REVIEW_IMG RI WHERE RI.REVIEW_ID = R.REVIEW_ID ORDER BY RI.IMG_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN USER U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW_HELPFUL RH ON R.REVIEW_ID = RH.REVIEW_ID AND RH.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND R.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW_IMG RI2 WHERE RI2.REVIEW_ID = R.REVIEW_ID )
AND ( R.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR R.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR U.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT ASC, R.REVIEW_ID ASC
ORDER BY R.HELPFUL_COUNT DESC, R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC
LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.USER_ID, O.ORDER_STATUS, OI.ITEM_ID, OI.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, ( SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID = #{userId} AND O.ORDER_STATUS IN ('DELIVERED', 'RETURN_COMPLETED') LIMIT 1
SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, DATE_FORMAT(O.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT OI.ITEM_ID AS itemId, OI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, O.ORDER_TYPE AS orderType, O.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, ( SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl,
CASE WHEN O.ORDER_TYPE = 'PURCHASE' AND O.ORDER_STATUS = 'DONE' THEN '배송완료' WHEN O.ORDER_TYPE = 'RENTAL' AND O.ORDER_STATUS = 'RETURNED' THEN '반납완료' ELSE '' END AS reviewStatusText,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID AND R.USER_ID = O.USER_ID AND R.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reviewWrittenYn FROM ORDER_ITEM OI INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY OI.ITEM_ID ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM REVIEW_IMG WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND IMG_ID NOT IN #{imgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW_HELPFUL ( REVIEW_ID, USER_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{userId}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO REPORT ( CONTENT, REPORT_STATUS, CREATED_AT, REVIEW_ID, USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{content}, 'WAITING', NOW(), #{reviewId}, #{userId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN USER U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND R.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW_IMG RI WHERE RI.REVIEW_ID = R.REVIEW_ID )
AND ( R.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR R.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR U.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
SELECT REVIEW_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, USER_ID FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET REVIEW_STATUS = 'BLOCKED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
